admin.title: AI
admin.subtitle: Your organization's model for writing help in the editor and chat summaries.
admin.enabledHint: When on, members see the AI buttons in the editor and in chat.

providerHint.anthropic: Anthropic's Claude models. Get a key at console.anthropic.com.
providerHint.openai: OpenAI's GPT models. Get a key at platform.openai.com.
providerHint.gemini: Google's Gemini models. Get a key at aistudio.google.com.
providerHint.mistral: Mistral AI models (hosted in Europe). Get a key at console.mistral.ai.
providerHint.azure_openai: The OpenAI resource in your organization's Azure subscription. Needs the resource address, a deployment name and an API version.
providerHint.openrouter: Models of many providers with one key. Get a key at openrouter.ai.
providerHint.openai_compatible: An OpenAI-compatible server: Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM, Groq, LM Studio. On your own server, data stays inside your organization.

admin.baseUrlHint: The address ending in /v1, e.g. http://llm.company.local:8000/v1
admin.modelHintOpenai: The model's name on your server.
admin.keyNote: The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
admin.keyWillDrop: Changing the provider or address removes the stored key; enter a new one.
admin.keyWillBeRemoved: The key will be removed when you save.
admin.quotaHint: Input and output tokens count. The quota resets on the 1st of every month (UTC). Leave empty for no limit.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Only content the person may see goes to the model; page and chat permissions are checked on the server for every request.
privacy.p2: Vault content is never sent to a model.
privacy.p3: The text sent and received is not stored; only token counts and the target are recorded.
privacy.p4: Every request and every result inserted into a page is in the audit log as "with AI".

admin.embeddingHint: The embedding model on your server for semantic search, e.g. bge-m3. Leave empty for full-text search only.

index.title: Search index
index.never: Not scanned yet; the scan runs every 5 minutes.

meeting.title: Meeting notes
meeting.hint: Recordings are transcribed on your own speech server (OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions, e.g. faster-whisper). The summary is written by the model above.
meeting.urlHint: The address ending in /v1; with the Docker Compose ai profile http://whisper:8000/v1
meeting.autoHint: When a recording is ready, its transcript, summary and meeting notes page are made on their own.

admin.baseUrlOverrideHint: Leave empty to use {address}. Enter it if your organization uses a proxy.
admin.deploymentHint: The deployment name you gave the model in the Azure portal.
admin.embeddingDefault: Suggested: {name}. Leave empty to keep semantic search off.
admin.onButBroken: On but not working: enter a provider and an API key, then test the connection.
admin.offerOn: The connection works. Turn AI assistance on now?
